scope: Native split/label checks and coarse recast review; not an exhaustive relabeling.
caveats: FaithDial uses stricter bot grounding than factual truth: personal disclosures and subjective additions can be marked unsupported even when its factual content is entailed. Human annotations can be debatable.
RAGTruth labels evidence grounding, not universal truth; preserve implicit_true and due_to_null span flags.
ComVE selects relative ordinary plausibility, not logical impossibility. Some choices exploit grammar or conventions.
